services.desc: When we remember the places we once visited we are often struck by a child like wonder wrapped in a feeling of nostalgia. Places we may visit again but never with the same sense of “new” as the first time. It is as if our memories are locked to our younger perceptions of ourselves and our lost past. We distort and individualize places, amplifying the good and slowly forgetting the bad. This series of works manifest those feelings through small, innocent child-like “Spirits” as they return to places where people once visited. For these initial paintings they wander New Orleans. services.desc: From 2009 to 2019, the Elaine Fleck Gallery published, printed, and distributed over 20,000 Fleck Fine Art Catalogues each year. This ambitious marketing initiative broadly promoted the Fleck Fine Art biannual exhibitions, which featured Gallery-represented artists, articles from leaders in the Canadian art world, and the "Best of New Submissions" from independent artists. From 2020 to 2025 the FLECK FINE ART Exhibitions, were promoted using social media and online advertising. These biannual Exhibitions featured the "Best of New Submissions" artists alongside Elaine Fleck Gallery represented artists.
